home.title: Organize sports tournaments with ease.
home.subtitle: Unipi Sports helps teams, referees, and organizers manage tournaments, matches, players, and results in one singular platform.

register.title: Register
register.subtitle: Create your Unipi Sports account.
register.roleHelp: Role selection is included for assignment demonstration purposes.

referee.subtitle: View your upcoming assigned matches and open each match sheet.

teams.browseSubtitle: View all teams registered in the platform.

tournaments.subtitle: Browse tournaments, teams, schedules, and standings.

registration.subtitle: Team managers can request participation before the tournament begins.

manualMatch.title: Create Match Manually
manualMatch.subtitle: Assign two accepted teams, a date/time, and a stadium.

matches.title: Matches
matches.subtitle: View tournament matches, scores, and match details.

statusControls.subtitle: Cancel, reopen, or finish the tournament. Finishing requires all matches to be completed.
